cases.description: Verify that visited links are successfully recorded to the Global History.

cases.description: Verify that after a server redirect, the correct link is recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Launch history link in browser window
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a history link causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Delete a History entry
cases.description: Verify that a History entry is successfully deleted.

cases.title: Delete Multiple History Entries
cases.description: Verify that multiple history entries are deleted and no longer displayed.

cases.title: Clear Global History
cases.description: Verify that the Global History is completely cleared when the clear action is triggered.

cases.title: Group History items by Day, Site, and None
cases.description: Verify that history items are successfully grouped by Day, Site, or None based on the grouping selection.

cases.title: Sort History per column
cases.description: Verify that history is sorted per column.

cases.title: Reverse-sort History per column
cases.description: Verify that history is reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns are resizable to show or hide more of entries.

cases.title: Show History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns are shown.

cases.title: Hide History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns are hidden.

cases.title: Re-visit recently visited sites via Back and Forward button dropdown menu
cases.description: Verify that recently visited sites can be re-visited by selecting them from the Back and Forward button dropdown menu.

cases.title: Create Empty Session History File for New Browser Window
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is created when a new browser window is opened.

cases.title: Create Empty Session History File for Browser Restart
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is created upon a browser restart.

analysis.analysis: R-073: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger - Visited link, Outcome - Recorded to Global History. R-074: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger - Server redirect, Outcome - Correct link recorded to Global History. R-075: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger - Clicking on a history link, Outcome - Launched in a browser window. R-076: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger - Delete action on a History entry, Outcome - History entry deleted. R-077: Multiple distinct behaviors, Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behaviors: Trigger - Delete multiple History entries, Outcome 1 - Multiple History entries deleted, Outcome 2 - Multiple History entries no longer displayed. R-078: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger - Clear action on Global History, Outcome - Global History cleared. R-079: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger - Grouping selection, Outcome - History items grouped by Day / Site / None. R-080: Multiple distinct behaviors, Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behaviors: Trigger 1 - Sort per column, Outcome 1 - History sorted per column; Trigger 2 - Reverse-sort per column, Outcome 2 - History reverse-sorted per column. R-081: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger - Resizing history columns, Outcome - Columns resized to show/hide more of entries. R-082: Multiple distinct behaviors, Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behaviors: Trigger 1 - Show history columns, Outcome 1 - Columns are shown; Trigger 2 - Hide history columns, Outcome 2 - Columns are hidden. R-083: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger - Selecting from Back and Forward button dropdown menu, Outcome - Recently visited sites re-visited. R-084: Multiple distinct behaviors, Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behaviors: Trigger 1 - New browser window, Outcome 1 - New empty session history file created; Trigger 2 - Browser restart, Outcome 2 - New empty session history file created.

coverage.feedback: The accepted cases provide a clean and direct mapping to the requirements without introducing any excess, overgeneration, repetition, or speculative behaviors not grounded in the text. Every requirement (R-073 through R-084) is covered appropriately, including splitting dual-state requirements like sorting (R-080), showing/hiding columns (R-082), and session creation contexts (R-084) logically into distinct test cases. There are no gaps or redundant edge cases identified.
